title: ID0399331-DC/Si-D/EE-[SqgCtw] - No metervalue when AC session stopped from car side
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer complains when AC charging session is aborted from car side (No app or RFID), charger sends “StopTransaction” message with no Wh value (0 Wh).
If AC session is aborted from dislay/RFID or using the app, StopTransaction” message has energy consumed value for example 0.250Wh.
I think software versions 3.x.x ….. 6.0.3 has a bug? OCPP configuration
Root cause: FW Bug
Solution: Bug Fix - FW v 7.0.0
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Active
EVC3 - 8226
